purpose: Offline planning dependencies only. No collection, human review, rights, model use, source admission, status promotion, SMTP or deployment.

waves.name: Vietnam existing families and MOD entrance gates
Japan lawful retrieval and narrower reliable scope
Korea original text and second independent issuer
Cross-desk cited evidence, timelines and dossiers

tasks.title: Attest per-source shadow slots and state heads
tasks.acceptance: Inventory every declared source family including scheduled, manually triggered and research-only families. Authenticate Actions attempts and immutable state only where collection actually exists; do not invent scheduled runs for the other cases.
tasks.stop_if: Missing attempt/state or unresolved mismatch stays unobserved, never healthy.

tasks.title: Review October 14 Day 7 MPS/MOIT packets
tasks.acceptance: After completed October 14 logical slot, pin separate heads and complete three source-specific original-language checks, attempt timeline and human signoffs.
tasks.stop_if: Any incomplete, late, inconsistent, unreviewed or source-mismatched receipt holds that family.

tasks.title: Adjudicate MOIT robots MIME anomaly
tasks.acceptance: Review publisher-served robots bytes, MIME anomaly and crawler-policy interpretation under existing permitted process; issue a source-specific exception or stop decision.
tasks.stop_if: Green workflow or zero new records cannot erase robots anomaly, waive policy or assert ministry silence.

tasks.title: Observe Vietnam MOD official listing access
tasks.acceptance: Owner separately authorizes merged manual robots-first #369 canary; pin actual Actions run, ref, attempt and observed block/result without article-body retrieval.
tasks.stop_if: 403, unreadable robots, challenge, redirects or uncertain policy mean blocked, not zero publications.

tasks.title: Decide rights for MPS/MOIT use and individual editorial citations
tasks.acceptance: Source-specific original-version, publisher permission/rights and metadata/short attributed-synopsis scopes; real named human and dates for each reviewed record.
tasks.stop_if: Metadata-use, private-model synopsis, full-text retention and public translation rights require distinct decisions.

tasks.title: Prove MOD article identity and legally reusable parser truth table
tasks.acceptance: Only after compliant access, independently check stable WCM keys, article title/date/issuer/byline/body and malformed/denial/pagination examples; record publisher rights scope separately.
tasks.stop_if: No direct first-party article or missing rights means fixture-only/held, never collection activated.

tasks.title: Complete October 21 Day 14 cohort review
tasks.acceptance: Complete October 21 logical slot and verify continuous independent source history, anomalies, original versions and distinct signed checkpoint packets.
tasks.stop_if: Do not auto-repair missed slots, inherit another family clock or count calendar time as a review.

tasks.title: Complete November 6 Day 30 cohort review
tasks.acceptance: After actual completed Nov 6 logical slot, close attempt audit, per-family 30-day evidence and human signed Day-30 receipts.
tasks.stop_if: Any missing successful day, review or licensed use must remain held; no automatic promotion.

tasks.title: Owner adjudicates limited Vietnam desk promotion
tasks.acceptance: Compare eligible source subset against C1–C13, document exclusions and review/legal findings, then require separate owner change control and explicit status decision.
tasks.stop_if: No change to live registry, production DB, source manifests, renderer, deployment or Brief rights in this plan.

tasks.title: Design independent MOD source shadow clock if warranted
tasks.acceptance: Separately review host policy, source adapter, isolated state branch, run-ledger and 7/14/30-day gates; new approval required for any collection activation.
tasks.stop_if: MOD is not one of the three existing ministry families and cannot share their evidence clock.

tasks.title: Qualify accessible Japan JCG article/PDF source scope
tasks.acceptance: Pin JCG state, source/rights scope, PDF extraction, human reviewer and actual scheduled continuity; name omitted/challenged items.
tasks.stop_if: Passing one PDF parser or a source listing is not broad Japan defense coverage.

tasks.title: Find compliant Japan MOD and additional institutional body routes
tasks.acceptance: Use publisher-authorized robots-readable listing/full-body routes and capture real denial proof; never evade a web challenge.
tasks.stop_if: 403/challenge or RSS metadata without article bytes remains retrieval blocked.

tasks.title: Complete Japan desk narrow-scope checkpoint evidence
tasks.acceptance: Bound actual eligible institution/source scope and produce independently reviewed source-fidelity/reliability/rights signoff for Day 7/14/30 as appropriate.
tasks.stop_if: Do not silently count inaccessible MOD HTML as working coverage or conflate JCG and MOD.

tasks.title: Owner considers Japan production-backed limited scope
tasks.acceptance: Assess narrow source's real C1–C13 evidence and whether public scope/name accurately describes accessible institutions; record an explicit owner decision.
tasks.stop_if: Shadow progress is not native production admission, broader ministry coverage or public Brief eligibility.

tasks.title: Human-verify Korean MND HWPX originals
tasks.acceptance: Verify original Korean source wording, HWPX reading order, tables, publisher/version identity, date semantics and text-only KOGL rights with a real reviewer.
tasks.stop_if: Parser success or KOGL page label does not license HWPX/images or prove original accuracy.

tasks.title: Design independent Korean DAPA source canary
tasks.acceptance: First-party robots/access, dated listing, source identity and separately reviewed terms; implement offline fixtures before any new shadow state.
tasks.stop_if: Cannot infer DAPA facts from syndicated MND metadata, claim a new source, or reuse the MND collector's clock.

tasks.title: Evaluate Korea multi-source reliability with separate clocks
tasks.acceptance: When sources individually qualify, verify original-language source review, complete slot attempts, source-bounded checks and distinct rights decisions.
tasks.stop_if: No Korea public desk exists in current registry; a working Korean shadow does not create one.

tasks.title: Owner considers Korea desk registry and source admission
tasks.acceptance: Separate formal registry proposal, fully reviewed source scope, 30-day continuity and production/rendering permission after human owner decision.
tasks.stop_if: No code in this program creates a Korea desk or changes any registry status.

tasks.title: Link admitted desk records to one source-attested weekly brief
tasks.acceptance: Produce exactly one thematic editorial manuscript using separately permitted production and typed source evidence; independently record offered/cited identities and omissions.
tasks.stop_if: A draft is not publication-ready; unused sources cannot be claimed as desk contributions.

tasks.title: Extend evidence timelines and dossiers without duplicating sources
tasks.acceptance: Re-use canonical records, original citations and entity/event taxonomy; preserve separate approval and unpublished states for timelines/dossiers.
tasks.stop_if: Never treat a topical dossier, media paraphrase or generated summary as a new official source.
